title: Jailbreak-Zero: A Path to Pareto Optimal Red Teaming for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the generation of hate speech against individuals or groups based on their religious affiliation, as part of a broader 'Hate' policy category.
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to religion. However, its overall finding is that the proposed 'Jailbreak-Zero' method is highly effective at generating policy-violating content across all categories, including hate speech based on religious affiliation. The provided examples for the 'Hate' policy demonstrate that the method can elicit content targeting Jewish people by disguising the prompts as educational inquiries or historical perspectives.
